description: From the viewpoint area, the malpaís lava field stretches out toward the Fire Mountains — black volcanic badlands rolling to the dark cones on the horizon under a starry sky. The twisted lava catches faint moonlight on its ridges while the volcanic cones stand in layered silhouette. Timanfaya is Lanzarote's raw volcanic heart; by night, in this artistic view, it feels like the surface of another planet.
